title: [XR-002] Role 1 §13 row15 deploy-gate verdict DEPLOY_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH inverted vs Role 4 canonical BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH
description: S13 backlog consistency pass. design/health-specialist-architect-design.md §13 row 15 (L489) states the adversarial-probe deploy gate accepts 'DEPLOY or DEPLOY_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH'. Role 4 (design/medical-safety-reviewer-design.md §4.4 row 1, L146) OWNS the deploy-verdict schema and defines the enum as {DEPLOY, BLOCK, BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH}. DEPLOY_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH is not a valid value AND is semantically inverted (Role 4's override-path BLOCKS pending adjudication). Live cross-session wiring bug (Role 1 authored S8, Role 4 enum finalized S12). MUST fix before Role 4 deploys (S15) — would mis-wire the orchestrator deploy gate. Role 4 canonical; fix Role 1 §13 row 15 to 'DEPLOY or BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH' via design-doc-change discipline. Confirm gate allow-list semantics with orchestrator.
close_reason: AC0 S15: reconciled Role 1 health-specialist-architect-design.md §13 row 15 (L489) inverted deploy-gate token. BEFORE: 'verdict = DEPLOY or DEPLOY_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH' (invalid enum value + semantically inverted). AFTER: 'verdict = DEPLOY or BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH'. Role 4 (medical-safety-reviewer §4.4 row 1) owns canonical deploy_verdict enum {DEPLOY, BLOCK, BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH}; override path attaches to a BLOCK pending medical-liaison adjudication, never a DEPLOY. Gate allow-list semantics confirmed by orchestrator: gate PASSES on DEPLOY|BLOCK_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH (clean deploy, or overridable-block subject to downstream adjudication), hard-FAILS only on BLOCK (CRITICAL, non-overridable except Role 1 invariant amendment). Minimal authorized in-place edit to Status:Final doc per bead authorization. rg confirms zero remaining DEPLOY_WITH_OVERRIDE_PATH across design/ + .claude/agents/. Fixed before /upgrade-agent so deployed Role 4 agent inherits the corrected enum (AC4 verifies).

title: PF-S12-01 structural fixes: session-b-debt mechanical enforcement
description:
Build the mechanical forcing functions that prevent AP-DEFERRED-LOOP-CLOSURE (PF-S12-01) recurrence. Currently the recurrence guard is documentation-only — same enforcement mechanism that failed 3 consecutive times (S10/S11/S12 close).

Five structural fixes per PF-S12-01:

1. Structural-1: CLAUDE.md scope-contract template — add mandatory 'Roster B status:' field stating which drafter slots are v1-substitute / deployed-canonical + cumulative-deferral count.

2. Structural-2: scripts/session-b-debt-audit.sh — reads HANDOFF.md scope-contract block, parses Roster B status field, exits 2 if cumulative-deferral count > 1. Add to close-protocol step 8.5 alongside the existing 3 audits. Smoke tests against fixtures with 0/1/2/3 cumulative-deferral count.

3. Structural-3: Auto-bead creation at design-doc-Final close. At every design-doc-Final close, create bead with title 'Session B for Role <N> (<role-slug>)', priority P2. After 1 cycle of non-action, manually promote P2 → P1. After 2 cycles, P1 → P0 (blocking). Mirrors hca P2 → P1 promotion ritual.

4. Structural-4: SESSION_KICKOFF.md drift-anticipation prohibition. Any sentence of form 'Most likely state at S<N>: ... v1-substitute / pending / not yet run' MUST be followed by either (a) explicit blocker flag with bead ID, or (b) explicit rationale why proceeding with that state is acceptable.

5. Structural-5: INV-SESSION-B-INTERLEAVING candidate invariant — promote to INVARIANTS.md register: 'Pass-2 design-doc-Final cycles may not stack >1 unclosed Session B obligation without explicit user override + cited rationale.' Requires user approval per change-discipline ritual.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: CLAUDE.md scope-contract template updated with Roster B status field
- AC2: scripts/session-b-debt-audit.sh ships with smoke tests; exits 0 on current HANDOFF.md (debt count documented); exits 2 when count > 1 without explicit override
- AC3: Close-protocol step 8.5 invokes session-b-debt-audit.sh alongside the other 3 audits
- AC4: Design-doc-Final close-protocol step appends 'create Session B bead' to the close-protocol checklist
- AC5: SESSION_KICKOFF.md template gains the drift-anticipation prohibition with explicit format constraint
- AC6: INV-SESSION-B-INTERLEAVING surfaced at next scope-contract with user-approval-ritual prompt (per INVARIANTS.md change-discipline)
- AC7: All existing audits still exit 0
- AC8: Smoke tests for session-b-debt-audit.sh pass (12/12 fixtures minimum)

Falsification window: if PF-S12-01 recurs at S13 (debt count = 3 at session-start AND forward Pass-3 work offered as first option) without these structural fixes in place, the documentation-only recurrence guard has failed empirically and the structural fix becomes blocking.

Cross-link: memory/process-failures.md PF-S12-01 (full failure analysis + 5 structural recommendations); HANDOFF.md S12 close note (drift-check post-PF revision).

Latent safety gap: a row-5 audit script (scripts/audit-safety-reviewer-output.sh --check h1h2-autoblock, PROPOSED) keying on top-level harm_class would PASS an H2-in-threat_model_cell block through (auto-block not fired). BLOCKS row-5 script LIVE promotion. Status:Final doc — fix via design-doc change discipline, not in-place. Deployed agent.md Rule 5 currently keys on 'harm_class' (could be made robust to read either field once canonical choice is made).
close_reason: PR #4 merged to main. Reconciled the H1/H2 auto-block key: top-level harm_class (composed final_harm_class) is canonical per §4.4 row 2; §13 row 5 + deployed Rule 5 key on it; §12.3 GOOD exemplar + deployed agent.md bromism GOOD now populate top-level harm_class: H2.
